temporal_methodology.base_model_evaluation_fit: all labeled training rows in each fold
temporal_methodology.calibrator_fit: later chronological calibration_fraction of each fold's training rows; probabilities produced by an earlier-only base fit
temporal_methodology.evaluation: next season only; labels never used for fitting

holdout_2026: not loaded, not scored, and not used for selection
selection_rule: calibrated pooled log loss and Brier must both beat raw, and log loss must improve in a strict majority of temporal folds
